8e1c657623526542f134.en: In an active sentence, the subject does the action.
8e1c657623526542f134.id: Dalam kalimat aktif (active sentence), subjek (subject) melakukan perbuatannya.

8a199525996ee40cfbaf.en: In a passive sentence, the subject has the action done to it.
8a199525996ee40cfbaf.id: Dalam kalimat pasif (passive sentence), subjek dikenai perbuatannya.

7ca7728791f846646271.en: The passive uses a form of be with a past participle.
7ca7728791f846646271.id: Kalimat pasif memakai salah satu bentuk be bersama past participle.

9d1f3f238c165d00d41b.en: Use the passive when the doer is unknown or less important than the action.
9d1f3f238c165d00d41b.id: Pakai kalimat pasif bila pelakunya tidak diketahui atau kurang penting dibanding perbuatannya.

f7039b60cd2cf224a64c.en: Science reports and formal writing often use the passive.
f7039b60cd2cf224a64c.id: Laporan sains dan tulisan resmi sering memakai kalimat pasif.
